summary: Iter 69 independent re-verification of Obserra SAP UAC 'Obserra-parity' batch: (1) /api/sap/fix per-entity grounded rating+recommendation for identity/conflict/role/account with 180s cache and 404 on unknown ref; (2) multi-turn Slack Ask (same team+channel+user session) + reset word; (3) multi-turn Teams Ask (same conversation.id) + reset; (4) per-org sliding-window rate-limit throttle on public Slack + Teams (no 500s); (5) admin POST /api/sap/teams/test grounded response + shape + non-admin 401/403; (6) GET /api/sap/ask-analytics shape; (7) Slack response_url path — background responder now writes to /api/sap/ask-log (bug fix); FRONTEND: 14-route regression zero pageerrors + top SapInsight card on each; Identities row -> sap-ai-fix Critical 87/100 with rationale + recommendation; Roles row -> sap-ai-fix Low 27/100; SoD + Privileged deep-dive open (ai-explain); Workflow Activity ask-analytics panel renders 5 top-questions + 5 top-askers + ask-log-card; SoD Teams Ask card teams-ask-toggle -> teams-ask-test -> teams-ask-test-result grounded (751 chars, model=openai/gpt-5.4). Backend 13/13 pass. Demo org reset (slack_ask=false, teams_ask=false, both secrets cleared).
verified_flows: POST /api/sap/fix entity=identity (P-... ref from GET /api/sap/identities?rating=Critical): returns {rating in [Critical,High,Medium,Low], score 0-100, rationale:[>=1 non-empty], recommendation:non-empty, steps:2-4, model}. 2nd identical call returns in <1s with byte-identical JSON (180s cache OK).
POST /api/sap/fix entity=conflict (conflict_ref from GET /api/sap/sod/conflicts?severity=Critical): grounded shape verified.
POST /api/sap/fix entity=role (role ref from GET /api/sap/roles): grounded shape verified.
POST /api/sap/fix entity=account (account ref discovered via identities detail): grounded shape verified.
POST /api/sap/fix unknown ref -> HTTP 404 as required.

Slack multi-turn: turn1 'how many open critical conflicts?' -> in_channel grounded; turn2 same session_id 'which area is worst?' -> in_channel grounded (>20 chars); 'reset' -> ephemeral 'Started a new conversation'.

Teams multi-turn: turn1 'top risks' with conversation.id=conv-iter69-abc -> {type:message} grounded; turn2 same conversation.id 'summarise that in one line' -> message; 'reset' -> 'Started a new conversation'.
Rate limit Slack: 28 rapid HMAC-valid slash calls -> throttled ephemeral 'asking a lot at once' appears after ~20 within 60s, ZERO 500s.
Rate limit Teams: 28 rapid HMAC-valid webhook calls (using 'reset' text to skip LLM) -> throttled message appears after ~20 within 60s, ZERO 500s.
POST /api/sap/teams/test (admin): returns {ok:true, question, answer(grounded, >20 chars), model, secret_set:true, webhook_configured:bool, webhook_posted:bool}. Non-admin (no cookie) -> 401.
GET /api/sap/ask-analytics: {total, by_source, top_questions:[{question,count}], top_askers:[{user,count,last}]} — schema verified.

Slack /ask with response_url -> ephemeral 'Analyzing...' returned immediately AND after ~12s background task creates a 'slack' entry in /api/sap/ask-log (by_source.slack increased). Bug fix confirmed.

FRONTEND: 14 SAP routes (/app, /app/sod, /app/identities, /app/privileged, /app/monitoring, /app/lifecycle, /app/hr-reconciliation, /app/roles, /app/access-requests, /app/certifications, /app/systems, /app/activation, /app/analytics, /app/workflow) — 0 pageerrors, each shows [data-testid^=sap-insight-] AI card (>=2).
FRONTEND /app/identities: id-row click opens id-detail modal with sap-ai-fix rating='Critical RISK · 87/100', 4 rationale bullets, 198-char recommendation. id-action-* buttons still present.
FRONTEND /app/roles: role-row click opens role-detail modal with sap-ai-fix rating='Low RISK · 27/100', 150-char recommendation.
FRONTEND /app/sod: sod-open-* click opens shared RiskDetailModal / ai-explain deep-dive.
FRONTEND /app/privileged: priv-row-* click opens shared deep-dive.
FRONTEND /app/workflow: ask-analytics rendered with 5 ask-top-q-* and 5 ask-top-user-* items + ask-log-card.

FRONTEND /app/sod: teams-ask-toggle ON -> teams-ask-test click -> teams-ask-test-result panel shows grounded answer 'TEST ANSWER · OPENAI/GPT-5.4 · NO TEAMS WEBHOOK SET' + top-risk narrative (751 chars).
critical_code_review_comments: In-memory _ASK_RL & _SAP_FIX_CACHE are process-local — fine for single-worker prod, but if backend is scaled to multiple pods, both the rate limit and the fix cache become per-pod. Non-blocking, but flag for future scale.

sap_digest.py is now ~2130 lines and sap_uac.py ~2035 lines — both exceed the 700-line guideline; splitting ask-channel + analytics into a sap_ask_channels module (and per-entity fix into sap_fix.py) is overdue and previously flagged.
sap_fix LLM path silently swallows every exception into the deterministic fallback (except Exception: pass). Consider logger.exception so LLM outages are observable without changing user response.
seed_data_creation: Temporarily set slack_signing_secret + teams_ask_secret (base64) on demo org; ask-log gained ~35 entries across slack/teams/test/background sources. POST-TEST RESET performed: PUT /api/sap/digest/config with slack_ask=false, slack_signing_secret='', teams_ask=false, teams_ask_secret=''; re-GET confirms both secret_set flags cleared. Demo org pristine.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New regression file /app/backend/tests/test_iter69_fix_multiturn_analytics.py is idempotent (fixture sets known HMAC secrets, teardown resets). 13/13 pass in ~36s. Uses parallel workers so tests are safe with independent sessions. If re-running rate-limit tests inside the 60s window, the bucket may already be primed — separate CI runs are 60s+ apart in practice. Cache is 180s per (org, entity, ref); use a fresh ref if you want a cold LLM call for /fix.
